relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a GFAP variant carrier: "DNA analysis of peripheral blood showed the presence of a R239L mutation in the GFAP gene".
method_note: Read in full by hand; a short script only assembled the JSON. In scope: the index patient (label 'patient'); his parents and older sister, tested and found to have a normal sequence (labels 'parent of patient', 'parent of patient 2', 'older sister of patient'; no variant rows, all checklist items not reported); and three previously published individuals with individual-level facts in the Discussion: Alexander's 1949 case (ref (2)), Wakabayashi et al. case (ref (12)) and Gingold et al. case (ref (14)). Group-level mentions (Brenner et al. 11 patients, Li et al. 44 cases) got no rows. Inheritance recorded as de novo because the parents were sequenced and normal and Fig. 3 legend says 'de novo', but the Discussion hedges: 'presumed to be a de novo mutation or gonadal mosaicism'. Zygosity is not stated for this person (only 'dominant mutations' in general), so not reported. Protein change printed only as 'R239L' (no p. prefix). MRI wording is inconsistent: Results say 'absence of myelination except in the frontal lobe and in a portion of the temporal lobe', whereas the Abstract says 'Demyelination in the frontal lobe and in a portion of the temporal lobe' and Fig. 2 describes frontal white-matter signal change; both statements recorded as observed features. Contradictions in the paper: (a) the text says 'Now, at age 30 months (Fig. 1C, D)' but the Fig. 1 legend says (C) and (D) are 'at the age of 20 months'; age at last evaluation taken from the text (30 months). (b) The text cites Fig. 4B for hypsarrhythmia at 11 months, but the Fig. 4 legend says 4B shows 'asynchronous high voltage multifocal spikes at the age 20 months'; both recorded as separate observed features with their own spans. Age at onset recorded from the authors' inference 'before at least age 3 months' with no ISO value (it is a bound). Seizure semiology (upward eyeball fixation, lip smacking) is ictal and was not used for the eye-movement checklist item. 'Intermittent vomiting' mapped to checklist 'recurrent vomiting'. Ref (2) 'rapidly enlarging head' mapped to macrocephaly. Normal CBC and normal urine NAA recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27); 'Anterior fontanel was soft and flat' recorded as excluded bulging fontanel but not used to exclude raised intracranial pressure. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null (not stated).
